Home / Services / Precious materials storage
13 / STORAGE

Preserve material identity while planning custody.

Storage of gold, precious metals and valuable specimens involves questions about identity, security, inventory records, access and the circumstances under which material can be released. Begin with the actual item and custody requirement.

THE SERVICE IN CONTEXT

A defined scope leads to a better decision.

Explore inventory identification, segregation, authorised access and release records.

The suitable approach depends on the material, the intended outcome and the details agreed by the parties.

Make a service enquiry ↗
A CLOSER LOOK

What deserves attention.

Different specimen forms and questions call for different considerations. The following themes help frame the discussion.

01

Identify the holdings

A suitable record should distinguish material description, item count, weight, distinguishing marks and any available identifiers. Whether items require segregation or sealed packaging depends on agreed custody arrangements.

02

Understand the custody arrangement

Location, access controls, security, record reconciliation, permitted inspections and responsibility for loss are contractual matters. No vault facilities, insured custody or particular storage jurisdiction are asserted by this page.

03

Release and transfer controls

Any release process should define authorised instructions, recipient verification, handover evidence and connection to transport or reporting records. Storage enquiry submission does not constitute a deposit or transfer instruction.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

What to prepare.

A few useful details can make your first enquiry much more focused.

  • Material type, form, quantity and approximate value
  • Preferred duration and custody objective
  • Packaging or segregation needs
  • Access and release-authorisation requirements
  • Relevant insurance, ownership or transport questions
Explore preparation guides ↗
COMMON QUESTIONS

A little more clarity.

Does ASL provide an insured vault automatically?+
Custody arrangements and insurance, if relevant, require a separately confirmed service agreement.
Can I deposit material by completing this form?+
No. An enquiry is not a custody agreement or an instruction to receive assets.
